headline: The eviction that shook Spain: New decree on rents – What changes | LiFO
summary: The Spanish government plans to approve a housing decree on rents at the Council of Ministers next Tuesday. The article outlines the changes it would introduce.
why: Rent regulation in Spain affects residential landlords, property investors and listed real estate companies with exposure to the Spanish rental market.
